title: Gilt
pitch: A dark Omarchy theme of cool obsidian, warm parchment, sovereign gold, and restrained jewel tones.
description: Parchment lettering on black stone, gold metalwork for focus and borders, and copper, jade, verdigris, lapis and amethyst as quieter accents. Ships seven wallpapers and a matching unlock screen.

externals.note: A browser mock-up of the Omarchy desktop in the theme's real colors and wallpapers. The windows are pictures, not running apps.
